data.headline: ## This page is *working from home.* ☕
data.body:
The URL exists in our heads, but not in this deploy. Likely culprits: a typo, a stale link, or a redirect we forgot to set up (Friday afternoon, naturally).

Try the homepage or just tell us — we read every report and usually fix the link the same day. Reminder: this is a demo site, so the page count is deliberately small — a real site would have many more landing pages to land on.
